subject: Makegood credit & one-time capacity top-up for September spike
messages:
From: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@mediapulse.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: billing@mediapulse.com
Date: 2026-10-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Unexpected September invoice spike — request for makegood

Vanessa,

Thanks for taking this — our October invoice came through and the September overage is larger than anticipated. We ran a quick internal check and saw an abrupt burst of inference hours tied to a new A/B experiment that wasn't fully throttled. The bill shows a one-off consumption of ~1.2M tokens beyond our committed capacity.

We'd like to request a one-time makegood credit and understand options for a short-term capacity top-up (we may need another 2 GPUs for two weeks in mid-November). Can you confirm next steps and what documentation you need from us for the reconciliation?

Attached is our usage export for September (CSV).

Claire
Head of ML Engineering
Mediapulse Media
Attachments: mediapulse_usage_sep.csv (CSV, 45KB)
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@mediapulse.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-21T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected September invoice spike — request for makegood

Hi Claire — thanks for the quick context and for sending the usage export. I’m sorry to hear about the experiment spike; we’ve seen similar patterns when feature flags flip unexpectedly.

Proposed next steps (quick):
- Ben (account lead) and I will validate the token breakdown and confirm whether the spike maps to pre-authenticated prefixes (should be visible in what you sent).
- If the spike is a one-off and post-renewal, we can propose a one-time makegood credit up to 60% of the overage while we finalize reconciliation.
- If you prefer, we can issue a one-off capacity top-up invoice for the temporary GPUs you mentioned; Karhtik can confirm availability and pricing for the two-week window.

Can you confirm the experiment run window (start/end) and whether those calls were made via the same API key(s)? That helps us exclude any orphaned keys or internal tests.

I’ve looped Ben and Karthik to get timing and an initial credit estimate. We’ll follow up with a proposed adjustment and a one-off invoice option by end of week.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@mediapulse.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-23T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected September invoice spike — request for makegood

Claire — I pulled the token-level logs and matched them to the CSV you sent. Highlights: 
- The burst maps to 2026-09-12T03:00:00Z -> 2026-09-14T18:00:00Z and originates from two API keys that belong to the same project.
- ~1.14M tokens in excess of your committed monthly capacity.
- There are no signs of compromised keys; looks like an unthrottled experiment.

Credit & top-up proposal:
- One-time makegood credit: 55% of the overage invoice amount, applied as a credit to November billing (can be paid out in invoice if you prefer cash).
- Temporary capacity: two g5-large GPU instances for a 14-day window (2026-11-15 -> 2026-11-28) at a one-off invoice of $9,600 (includes reserved burst capacity and 24/7 support).

If that sounds reasonable, we’ll prepare a short invoice for the capacity and a bill adjustment line item reflecting the credit. I’ve attached a draft invoice for the one-off capacity and a reconciled usage CSV.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed_oneoff_invoice_20261026.pdf (PDF, 12KB), reconciled_usage_sep.csv (CSV, 22KB)
From: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@mediapulse.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: billing@mediapulse.com
Date: 2026-10-26T17:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected September invoice spike — request for makegood

Thanks Ben and Vanessa — I reviewed the draft and the reconciled numbers. Mediapulse accepts the 55% makegood credit and would like the one-off capacity invoice issued so we can process the PO internally. Two small asks:
1) Can you add a short statement on the invoice that the capacity charge is for a temporary spot/managed GPU top-up (dates included) so our procurement team can match it to the PO?
2) We’ll need the credit to be visible on the November invoice (not as a separate credit memo).

I’ve attached a signed PO cover note (billing@mediapulse.com will send the formal PO later today). Once you confirm the invoice wording we can approve.

—Claire
Attachments: mediapulse_po_cover.txt (TXT, 1.2KB)
